solutions.meta.title: Robotics solutions for business | Professional Robotics
solutions.meta.description: Robotics areas: cleaning, warehouse logistics, service robots, security, construction, healthcare, agriculture. Turnkey deployment and SLA-backed service.
solutions.hero.lead: We build each solution from equipment by different manufacturers, choosing what genuinely fits and can be serviced, not what we happen to have exclusive rights to. Below are the areas where we have the equipment, the scenarios and the service.
solutions.hero.text: Each area is not just a robot but a package: equipment selection, integration, staff training and maintenance. A robot without service soon stops working. We are responsible for keeping it running.
solutions.hero.facts.label: The areas at a glance
solutions.directions.title: Nine areas. One task: yours.
solutions.directions.items.cleaning.text: Robotic floor scrubbers for offices, malls, warehouses and terminals. The area with the clearest payback.
solutions.directions.items.warehouse.tex: Autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), carts and follow-me robots for internal logistics and moving goods.
solutions.directions.items.service.text: Delivery and guest service in hotels, restaurants and clinics.
solutions.directions.items.medical.text: Delivery, disinfection and support tasks in clinics.
Demolition, finishing and heavy work where people are scarce or the job is dangerous.
solutions.directions.items.agro.text: Fieldwork, spraying, monitoring and grounds care.
solutions.directions.items.humanoid.text: An emerging area for service and front-of-house roles, built to a specific request.
solutions.scenarios.title: What you can automate.
solutions.scenarios.lead: From task to solution: choose what needs doing and we’ll show the matching area.
solutions.composition.title: What a solution includes.
solutions.composition.lead: Each area combines four parts. It’s not just a robot in a box.
solutions.composition.parts.selection.te: We compare 2–5 manufacturers and choose what fits and can be serviced.
We connect the robot to your processes, premises and systems.
solutions.composition.parts.training.tex: We teach your staff to work alongside the robot and operate it.
solutions.composition.parts.service.text: We service it and answer for results. A robot without service soon stops working.
